continuity_scope: Original English-language Game Boy Advance Golden Sun manual witness (Nintendo/CAMELOT, 2001), limited to its early-Adept profile pages; Nintendo’s 16 January 2024 Switch Online news is used only to distinguish the original Golden Sun and Golden Sun: The Lost Age as separately described games. The 2024 NSO service, The Lost Age, Dark Dawn, ports, and any localization revisions are not merged.
work_or_witnesses: Nintendo, Golden Sun Game Boy Advance Instruction Booklet, English manual pages 10–11 (EU archive PDF)
Nintendo of America, New update! A pair of golden games have been added for Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack members, 16 January 2024
coverage_rule: All four individually named Adepts with a dedicated profile on the selected original English manual pages: Isaac, Garet, Ivan, and Mia. The adjacent manual material and later Nintendo news mention other figures, but they lack a selected standalone profile and are excluded. Elements, Adepts, Djinn, Psynergy, Alchemy, Elemental Stars, lighthouses, weapons, locations, and systems are terms/dimensions, never nodes.
omissions: All named characters without a dedicated selected original-manual profile, including Jenna, Saturos, Menardi, Felix, Sheba, Piers, Babi, and later opponents/NPCs.
Player party/formation, Djinn combinations, Psynergy use, equipment, battle outcomes, elemental-lighthouse state, and all optional or sequel-dependent conclusions.
Golden Sun: The Lost Age, Dark Dawn, Wii U/NSO presentation and rewind/save behavior, other localizations/editions, crossovers, fan wikis, Wikipedia, walkthroughs, and community databases.
uncertainties: The Nintendo archive is an OCR-extracted large PDF; the visible manual text is direct but its web-search transcription contains obvious name rendering errors. Character names and traits are retained only where the named profile/card layout is clear, and evidence is described as an archival manual witness.
The manual pages are a limited early-character presentation rather than a full game script/cast; pass-complete applies strictly to four profile cards.
Nintendo’s 2024 news summarizes The Lost Age’s later premise and names original-game antagonists, but is not used to backfill the original’s later plot or identities.
The original manual’s English text and regional release are not treated as proof of identical later localization or NSO behavior.
evidence_basis: Nintendo-hosted original English GBA manual pages for character-level evidence, plus Nintendo of America’s official 2024 release news only for original/sequel/NSO separation. No fan source is used as canonical evidence.
